name: Ensemble Kalman Inversion
summary: Derivative-free or derivative-light iterative parameter inference via ensemble Kalman-style updates.
core_idea: Iteratively update an ensemble of unknown parameters toward observations by applying the forward model.
innovation: Adapts ensemble covariance updates from sequential assimilation to static nonlinear inverse problems.
limitations: The algorithm can collapse or be biased without suitable regularization.
May fail to represent multimodal posterior uncertainty faithfully.

start_here.why: Foundational inverse-problem adaptation of ensemble Kalman methods.
start_here.focus: Distinguish parameter inversion updates from filtering dynamical states.

curation_note: Core method concept and checked source(s) recorded; suggested readings remain advisory and may be revised.
